baseline.name: CDKM ripple-carry (Cuccaro et al. 2004)
baseline.structure: n MAJ stages LSB->MSB on one carry ancilla, then n UMA stages MSB->LSB; 2n Toffolis, 1 carry ancilla

lower_bound_attempt.method: multiplicative_complexity_lb (span search over degree>=2 products with <=ancillas ancillas), max_depth=10
lower_bound_attempt.targets: all n sum bits s_i(a,b) as truth-table-packed fns over nvars=2n (a high bits, b low bits)
lower_bound_attempt.interpretation: Superseded by the strengthened certificate below (the multiplicative_complexity_lb helper early-returns depth+1 on first failure, so these LB=2 entries reflect only a depth-1 probe).

improved_construction_2n_minus_2.name: 2n-2 Toffoli in-place adder (skip the top MAJ/UMA pair; read the top sum bit off the carry chain)
improved_construction_2n_minus_2.idea: CDKM computes the top carry c_n it then immediately discards; skipping the top MAJ stage and UMA stage and XORing the chain carry c_{n-1} directly into a[n-1] (with b[n-1]) yields the top sum bit, saving 2 Toffolis at identical qubit count. Carries c1..c_{n-1} for the remaining bits are still computed and uncomputed pairwise, so the single carry ancilla returns to |0> (clean).
improved_construction_2n_minus_2.gate_count_matches_known_order: 2n-2 Toffoli in-place adders are known in the literature (Takahashi-Kunihiro 2005 use 2n-2 Toffolis with no ancillas; our variant keeps 1 carry ancilla). NOT claimed as a novel gate-count record; claimed contributions are the verified construction + span-model certificate + the agent-vs-hand audit.

strengthened_certificate_n3.method: direct exhaustive 2-product span search: product_span_search(space, targets, 2, first_op, ancillas) over ALL 651 first-op product vectors; plus a 3-product witness
strengthened_certificate_n3.targets: s1, s2 (s0 has empty degree>=2 part) over nvars=6; target vecs 0x10, 0x81040
strengthened_certificate_n3.two_product_result: impossible for every one of the 651 first ops (5.7 s exhaustive) => no 2-Toffoli-product circuit computes the n=3 adder under the span model (<=2 ancillas)
strengthened_certificate_n3.three_product_witness: products {a0*b0, a1*b1, a0*b0*(a1 xor b1)} span all degree>=2 parts (search finds the span in 0.1 s with first_op = a0*b0); p3 packs the two degree-3 monomials a0a1b0 ^ a0b0b1 of c2 into one product
strengthened_certificate_n3.conclusion: multiplicative complexity of the n=3 in-place adder = exactly 3 in the span model; our T=4 construction is within 1 of span-optimal and T<=2 is provably impossible
strengthened_certificate_n3.rank_certificate: dim span of degree>=2 parts of all sum bits: n=3: 2, n=4: 3, n=5: 4 => T >= 2, 3, 4 (weak, superseded for n=3 by the exact-3 certificate)
